meta.title: [2026 Update] Best Nomad Insurance: 'SafetyWing' Review.
meta.desc: Perfect for nomads with undefined plans. Monthly subscription travel/medical insurance. Why it's the top choice globally after credit card insurance expires.

hero.title:
No Fixed Return Date Needed.
'Subscription' Insurance for Nomads

intro.p1: The biggest worry for overseas nomads. Isn't it "Insurance"?
intro.p2:
Credit card insurance expires in the "first 90 days".
But Japanese travel insurance often requires a fixed return date or a large lump-sum payment...

"I want insurance that is freer and more flexible."
intro.p3:
Born from the voices of nomads worldwide is the Norwegian startup "SafetyWing".
Pay monthly like Netflix, cancel anytime. Truly insurance for digital nomads.
intro.check1: 3 reasons SafetyWing is best for nomads
intro.check2: Decisive difference from credit card insurance
intro.check3: Are motorbike accidents or dental covered? Detailed coverage FAQ

1.title: Full Subscription. Cancel Anytime.
1.desc:
Auto-renewal every 4 weeks. If you decide "I'm going home next month", just turn off auto-renewal in your dashboard.
No penalties, no fees. For nomads with flexible schedules, this is the biggest benefit.

2.title: Not just Medical. Covers Travel Troubles too.
2.desc:
Covers medical expenses, plus lost checked luggage, travel delays, and emergency evacuation.
Though called "Nomad Insurance", it functions as solid "Comprehensive Travel Insurance".

3.title: Covers "Home Visits" too
3.desc:
For every 90 days, you get up to 30 days of medical coverage in your home country (Japan, etc. except USA).
Safe if you catch a cold or get injured during a temporary return. A rare feature among international insurances.

bike.desc: Covered if you have a valid license for the engine size (e.g., IDP) and wear a helmet. Unlicensed driving is not covered.

dental.desc: Only for emergency pain relief or accidental injury to sound natural teeth. Checkups and cleanings are not covered.

covid.desc: Treated like any other illness. Testing and treatment are covered if deemed medically necessary by a physician.

laptop.desc: Not in standard plan, but for +$10/month, you can add theft coverage up to $1000/item (max $3000/year).

pricing.title: Surprisingly Low Price
pricing.desc:
For about $2/day, you get up to $250,000 medical coverage.
Considering Japanese travel insurance costs $100-200/month, the value is overwhelming.

deductible.title: Important! About Deductible
deductible.desc: One thing you MUST know before signing up is the "Deductible".
deductible.boxDesc:
You pay the first $250 of medical costs; SafetyWing pays the rest.
So, "Saw a doctor for a cold ($50)" is not reimbursed. Think of it as insurance for major troubles like "Hospitalization & Surgery ($3000)".
deductible.boxNote: * The $250 is "per policy period", not "per incident". Once you pass $250, subsequent claims are covered from dollar one.

cta.title: Buy Peace of Mind. Start the Adventure.
cta.desc:
Don't know when you'll return?
SafetyWing supports your free journey.
